purpose: Pipeline-equivalence control (D-01): does the SageMaker CUDA pipeline reproduce the Mac (mps:0) Phase 10 antisemitism-v1 three-seed mean margin within the owner-approved band, on identical inputs, recipe, epochs and seeds, with the gate passing unwaived?
must_note: The owner-accepted draft's must.gate_pass_unwaived is NOT carried in this declaration, because laya_repro_eval.py check_declaration_obj refuses an unknown must clause (it would never be evaluated). Its job is carried by class pass (the gate passed and the pack carries waived null) plus the ece_post ceiling 0.10, which is the gate's own bar (max_ece). This is a deviation from the owner-accepted draft: the owner was told of it on 2026-11-01 and did not object, which is not an approval and is not claimed as one. deploy_eligible is the pack task's recorded verify (logs/pack-outcome.json), which the evaluator reads, on the amended pack image sha256:dd38865c43aba2f3819e50addcf6db5e9da94ef84e762d93cf6b2c132f1d17e2 under laya-parity-v1 A2; a local laya-verify refusal on this Mac is a recorded cross-CPU finding, never a gate.
band_note: margin: the Mac reference three-seed mean 0.2392 plus or minus 0.030, as the owner accepted it on 2026-11-01 ('Acceptable.'). ece_post: the ceiling 0.10 is the gate's max_ece; the floor 0.0 excludes nothing because ECE is never negative, the owner asked for the gate bar only (D-03).

judging.note: The margin clause is the mean of the three seed margins, the statistic the Mac reference is summarised by, so per-seed device noise does not decide the verdict; the ece clause, the gate and the pack stay on the shipped seed.

retry.rule: attempt_cap is 1 and retry_classes is empty: there is no second attempt. A run that ends before any gate verdict (crash, quota, timeout: the fetched logs/outcome.json exit_class is refused or crash, with no run/gate-report.json and no GATE PASS or GATE FAIL line in logs/train.log) is not an attempt; it is recorded under pre_verdict_failures and any re-run needs the owner's new approval. A run whose gate executed (exit_class pass or gate_fail, a gate report, or a GATE line) is the attempt even when a file failed to upload. A run whose evidence is missing or inconclusive (no fetch, no outcome.json) is unresolved and is decided by the owner, never counted as not an attempt. A miss is recorded not-reproduced with next_trusted false; nothing after a miss is pre-authorized. A run stopped by the training server's 21,600 s runtime cap ends before any gate verdict, so it is a timeout and is not an attempt (D-06); re-running it needs the owner's new approval.

waiver_note: No waiver and no overrides entry exists for these inputs (D-09): the contract's only pilot waiver, motivation-v1-pilot-ece, binds the motivation-v1 input hashes, and the offline preflight proves none applies to these. Were one ever to apply it would count as inconclusive under waiver_rule, never as reproduced.

run.name: antisemitism-v1-cuda-ctl
run.note: the evaluator reads inputs by sha256 and never the prefix, so the prefix is informational

compute.mps_reference: wall 16,822 s; ~4,900 s per seed; 4.13 h three-seed training (s_per_step 1.47 on MPS)
compute.cuda_estimate: UNMEASURED. Scaling the motivation-v1 CUDA run (295 rows x 12 epochs = 3,540 row-epochs in 1,203 s) to 8,510 x 4 = 34,040 row-epochs gives ~3.2 h, but sequence lengths differ, so treat it as 2-6 h.
compute.risk: a run over the 6 h cap ends as a timeout (pre-verdict, not an attempt) after the money is spent. The first step is a cheaper measurement, see next_steps.

paired_report_only: per-seed CUDA minus MPS margin and ECE, descriptive, never pass/fail (same seed gives different numbers across devices).
claim_scope: pipeline equivalence on THIS task only: it asks whether the SageMaker CUDA pipeline reproduces the Mac (mps:0) Phase 10 antisemitism-v1 three-seed mean margin within the band [0.209, 0.269] on identical inputs and recipe, with the gate passing unwaived; it does not reproduce motivation-v1; it does not set next_trusted for the Phase 14 training server; it does not change Phase 14's trust bar (P14-D-16) or Phase 15's SC4 outcome; whether a pass redefines trust is a separate owner ruling; per-seed CUDA-minus-MPS differences are reported descriptively and never judged; bytes differ by design and no determinism claim is made.
changes_from_reference: device: mps:0 (this Mac) -> cuda:0 on the SageMaker ml.g5.xlarge instance

driver: the local script (just laya-train) -> the Phase 14 training server, packed by the Graviton pack task on the amended image sha256:dd38865c43aba2f3819e50addcf6db5e9da94ef84e762d93cf6b2c132f1d17e2
the torch build: the Mac run used torch 2.14.0; the container carries its own build
unchanged: the inputs (the three digests), the recipe id, 4 epochs, seeds 13, 17 and 23
run_authorization_rule: Per D-07 the paid run needs a per-run owner go, recorded by the orchestrator as 16-RUN-GO.json (schema laya-run-go-v1), bound to this declaration's first-add commit and sha256 and checked by check-run-go; this file never changes, so run_authorized stays false here.
